title: Software Trigger CPU<->CLA
text: Trigger software events between processor (CPU) and control law accelerator (CLA), 1 input, 1 output; {Task number} sets the task identification number, {Trigger condition} sets the condition to trigger an event and {Trigger type}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Task number
params.values: Task identification number 1 (default) | integer from 1 to 8

params.name: Trigger condition
params.values: Condition to trigger an event Rising edge (default) | Input high
